title: NordicIntel dataset metadata
description: Normalized dataset metadata for one language. Different language versions are separate documents with the same provider_code, dataset_code and dataset_id.

dataset_code.description: Opaque, case-sensitive source dataset code, unique within its provider and shared across language versions. Do not slugify.

dataset_id.description: Language-independent identifier: provider_code + ":" + dataset_code, e.g. scb:TAB335. Preserve the original dataset code.

language.description: Language of this metadata document; no silent language fallback.

label.description: Human-readable dataset name/title, as given by the provider.

source.description: Attribution text naming the Dataset source according to the Provider, in this document's language. This is not the Provider identity or a URL; resource targets belong in links. Omit or use null when unknown.

description.description: Longer free-text description of the dataset.

discontinued.description: Whether publication or updates for this Dataset have stopped. False means explicitly active; omission or null means unknown.

updated.description: Provider-reported update date or timezone-aware timestamp, not harvest time. This is the last time the Dataset changed, including observation, structural, or metadata changes. Preserve date-only precision when that is all the Provider supplies. Omit or use null when unknown.

official_statistics.description: Provider-reported official national statistics status. Preserve true, false and unknown (omitted or null); never infer it solely from provider identity.

time_unit.description: Granularity of statistical time periods, not publication frequency. Use other for a known granularity outside the enum; omit or use null when unknown.

first_period.description: First period covered by the Dataset, either reported by the Provider or inferred by a local implementation; not necessarily a category label. Preserve the Provider's original form instead of standardizing it.

last_period.description: Last period covered by the Dataset, either reported by the Provider or inferred by a local implementation; not necessarily a category label. Preserve the Provider's original form instead of standardizing it.

next_release.description: Date/datetime of the next expected release of the dataset, as announced by the provider.

notes.description: Ordered dataset-level explanatory notes in the document language. Dimension and category notes belong at their corresponding levels.

label.description: Subject name in this document language.

subject.description: Primary thematic classification with code, localized label or both. Omit when unavailable; null and empty objects are not accepted.

time.description: Existing dimension codes assigned the time role; references and cross-role uniqueness are application checks.

geo.description: Existing dimension codes assigned the geo role; references and cross-role uniqueness are application checks.

metric.description: Existing dimension codes assigned the metric role; references and cross-role uniqueness are application checks.

role.description: Semantic roles assigned to existing dimension codes. Each supplied array is nonempty and unique; array order need not follow dimension order. Applications enforce at most one role per dimension.

dimension_ids.description: Complete ordered dimension codes. Array order establishes statistical dimension order, not object-key order. Applications check exact correspondence with dimension keys.

dimension.description: Complete dimension metadata keyed by source dimension code, including labels in this document language. Ordering is supplied by dimension_ids.

links.description: Related resources with explicit relations and optional target language. A data link does not encode request bodies or replace private retrieval settings.

paths.description: Ordered thematic chains from broader to narrower nodes. Multiple chains describe multiple thematic memberships, never API routes or dataset lookup keys.

contacts.description: Structured source contacts. Each object requires at least one populated field; omit or use null when unavailable. No raw contact field.

stringArray.description: Nonempty ordered list of nonblank strings; the containing property defines whether these are codes or text.

id.description: Original thematic node identifier, not a dataset access key.

label.description: Thematic node label in the document language.

link.description: Optional classification or documentation resource for this node.

path_node.description: One thematic node identified by source code and localized label, with optional supporting resource.

path_array.description: A nonempty thematic chain, ordered from broad to narrow classification.

dateOrDatetime.description: Source calendar date or RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone; null means unknown. Enable date and date-time format checks.

rel.description: Link relation. Common names are examples, not an exhaustive enum; custom nonblank relation names are allowed.

href.description: Absolute HTTP(S) resource URL with a host.

hreflang.description: Optional target language; omit if unknown or not language-specific.

href_link.description: Resource target and its relationship to the dataset or thematic node. Request execution settings remain outside Dataset.

email.description: Email address, not a mailto URL; enable email format checking.

phone.description: Telephone number as text, preserving prefixes and extensions.

address.description: Postal or visiting address as source text.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) contact page; this field is a direct URL string, not a Link object.

contact.description: Source contact with at least one nonblank field. Unknown keys and null fields are rejected.

label.description: Original dimension name in the document language.

category.description: Indexed categories and localized labels, with optional notes and units by category.

note.description: Ordered explanatory notes applying to the whole dimension.

extension.description: Additional metadata with arbitrary JSON contents, including scalar values and nested objects. No adapter-specific schema is required. Do not duplicate defined fields.

elimination.description: Whether this dimension may be omitted from a data selection. Construction default is false. True does not require an elimination_value; validation inserts neither default.

elimination_value.description: Optional category code to use when this dimension is omitted. Null when unspecified. A supplied code must exist in the category index; application validation enforces this relationship.

jstat_dimension.description: One dimension with localized label and complete category maps. Its code is the enclosing map key.

jstat_category.description: Normalized JSON-stat-style category maps. Ordering comes from explicit index values, not map iteration.

index.description: Category code to zero-based integer position. Applications enforce uniqueness and contiguous positions from zero.

label.description: Original localized labels by category code. Applications require labels for exactly the indexed codes.

note.description: Category code to ordered notes; each key must reference an existing category.

label.description: Unit text in this document language, e.g. antal or number.

decimals.description: Nonnegative decimal places for display; not a statement of measurement accuracy.

position.description: Placement of unit text relative to the displayed value: start or end.

additionalProperties.description: Source unit text and optional display information; at least one field is supplied.

unit.description: Units by existing category code, commonly on a metric dimension. Omit unknown units.

extension.description: Additional metadata with arbitrary JSON contents, including scalar values and nested objects. No adapter-specific schema is required. Do not duplicate defined fields.

nonblank.description: At least one non-whitespace character; validation does not trim or normalize text.

language_code.description: Supported metadata languages: Swedish (sv) and English (en).

$comment: Defaults are annotations, not inserted values. Applications check combined identity, dimension membership, contiguous unique category positions, complete category labels, note/unit/role references, at most one role per dimension, and elimination references. See ../DATASET-MODEL.md.
